name: AvoidRafa

global_influences.evidence: Founder Raef Al Hasan Rafa spent roughly fifteen years as Aurthohin's drummer and vocalist before AvoidRafa became his own vehicle; his playing vocabulary and the band's progressive/hard-rock orientation carry directly from that tenure. This is a domestic transmission link rather than a global one.
global_influences.source: The Daily Star profile of Raef Al Hasan Rafa; Dhaka Tribune, 'A musical session with AvoidRafa' (2019)

global_influences.artist_or_genre: Heavy metal, progressive metal and hard rock traditions (general)
global_influences.evidence: Rafa's documented stylistic range across projects spans heavy metal, progressive metal, death metal, hard rock and art rock; AvoidRafa sits at the hard-rock/progressive end of that range.
global_influences.source: Encyclopedic profile of Raef Al Hasan Rafa; MN2S artist roster listing

local_adaptation_notes: Performs in Bangla. The project began as a solo outlet for a musician already established inside the band system, which is itself characteristic of the 2010s scene: established players spinning off named projects rather than joining existing bands.
sound_evolution_summary: Debut album 'Bhaar' (2016) established the project; the act has since moved from a solo studio vehicle to a live band appearing on major festival bills (Joy Bangla Concert 2020, 2023, 2024).
concert_culture_notes: Formed in the context of the RockNation: The Revolution of Rock bill (2014), when Aurthohin could not perform and Rafa filled the slot for an audience that had already bought tickets — an unusually well-documented instance of a band being created by the demands of the live circuit rather than the studio. Subsequently a recurring Joy Bangla Concert act (2020, 2023, 2024, the last in Chattogram).
listener_community_notes: Audience overlaps heavily with Aurthohin's, and with the festival-going rock audience that the Joy Bangla Concert series assembled between 2015 and 2024.
